trait.name: Voisko
trait.text: Choose one host when recruiting. Don: thrown Off the Saddle only on a 1. Kuban: no -1 to hit for shooting after moving. Siberian: ignores rough terrain.

trait.name: Shame the Men
trait.text: Friendly Soldiers within 8 cm get +1 to Conviction tests.

trait.name: Za Yedinuyu i Nedelimuyu!
trait.text: For a United and Indivisible Russia! While he is the Commander, his Orders have no -1 for distances over 16 cm.

trait.name: Psychic Attack
trait.text: A Soldier he Charges cannot react with Shoot.

trait.name: Molitva
trait.text: Prayer. Friendly Soldiers within 16 cm get +1 to Conviction tests. He may Agitate.

trait.name: Well-equipped
trait.text: His firearms have Supply one better.

trait.name: Adrian Helmet
trait.text: The first time a 6 is rolled on the Wound table against him, the attacker rerolls it.

trait.name: Proletarians
trait.text: When he Flees, he moves only half his MS.

trait.name: Political Worker
trait.text: Once per Round, one friendly Soldier within 16 cm automatically passes a Discipline test, but has one fewer action in his next activation. Works whether or not the Commissar has activated. He may Agitate.

trait.name: Cool Head, Warm Heart, Clean Hands
trait.text: Enemy Soldiers within 16 cm cannot benefit from, or be targeted by, faction or subfaction rules used during play.

trait.name: Under Watch
trait.text: While he is the Commander, his Orders get +1 if a friendly Commissar is within 16 cm of him, and -1 if not.

trait.name: Exceptional Marksmen
trait.text: With a rifle, his long-range modifier is one step better.

trait.name: Proletarier aller Länder, vereinigt euch!
trait.text: Workers of the world, unite! While a friend is within 8 cm, his Training is 3.

trait.name: Le a burzsoáziával!
trait.text: Down with the bourgeoisie! +1 to Discipline tests while an enemy is within 16 cm.
